events.headline: Rippling launches plugins, skills, and automations in Rippling AI
events.summary: Rippling introduced AI capabilities that connect approved third-party systems, package repeatable instructions, and automate recurring work under existing policies and permissions.

events.headline: Rippling opens new 132,693-square-foot New York City office
events.summary: The office at 330 West 34th Street will support more than 1,000 employees and nearly doubles Rippling’s previous New York footprint.

events.headline: Rippling expands Preferred Carrier Program with Principal, Beam Benefits, and Sun Life
events.summary: The additions brought the program to six preferred carriers and expanded employers’ and brokers’ access to carriers with deeper Rippling integration out of the box.
